editor_notes.factual_accuracy:
Cross-checked essentially every specific against the snapshots. VERIFIED verbatim/accurate: 21.7% subscriber loss to ~641,000 (SpaceNews, source-0, exact figures present); $1.5B debt Hughes could not repay (SpaceNews, RBR, Advanced Television all corroborate the $1.5B figure independently); $1.5B contracted enterprise backlog (SpaceNews); 400 employees notified in late July, 60-day transition, late-September departures (SpaceNews); broadband/satellite services revenue down 6.7% to $317M for the quarter ended June 30 (SpaceNews) vs SDxCentral's 'near 7%' figure for the same division, correctly attributed to each outlet separately; operating income swing from $36.7M loss to $50.5M gain and ~59,000 lost connections (SDxCentral, exact figures); six GEO satellites / 69 terrestrial gateways (SpaceNews); $23B AT&T spectrum sale delivering 'just over $20 billion in cash' (SDxCentral, exact wording); Dish's 'during the second half of 2026' emergence timeline from the 10-Q (SDxCentral, exact quote); all named executive moves (Paul Gaske ~46 years at Hughes, COO since early 2023, resigning to senior advisor; Robert del Genio as CRO; Ramesh Ramaswamy as EVP/GM; Michael Buenzow and Anthony Horton as independent directors; Hamid Akhavan's earlier resignation) match SDxCentral verbatim. Charlie Ergen quotes verified against source-1: the 'does not include EchoStar Corporation...' quote and the 'we're paying our employees...' quote are exact verbatim matches. The '$1.5 billion in upcoming bond payments' / 'We had discussions with the bondholders...we filed Chapter 11' quote is verbatim for the words inside quotation marks, but the source's full sentence continues '...bankruptcy this morning for Hughes' — the article silently drops 'bankruptcy this morning' and moves 'for Hughes' outside the quote marks without an ellipsis. No words are altered or fabricated, so this is noted as a minor, non-corrections-worthy style issue rather than a misquote.

CROSS-SOURCE DATE DISCREPANCY (explicitly requested verification): CONFIRMED REAL. SpaceNews (source-0) states verbatim: 'Hughes lacked the cash needed to repay about $1.5 billion of debt by an Aug. 3 deadline.' RBR (source-2) states: 'its inability to repay some $1.5 billion owed to debtholders by an August 1 due date.' Advanced Television (source-3) states: 'August 1st was the maturity date covering $1.5 billion of borrowings.' The article's 'What We Don't Know' section states: 'Coverage of the filing differs slightly on the exact date the underlying $1.5 billion bond payment came due: SpaceNews referred to an "Aug. 3 deadline," while Advanced Television and RBR both reported the note matured Aug. 1.' This is an accurate, verbatim-quoted summary of a genuine discrepancy, correctly placed in a disclosed-uncertainty section rather than asserted as settled fact anywhere else in the body — the Overview's 'the company said Aug. 3' is itself a verbatim paraphrase of SpaceNews's own framing ('The company said Aug. 3 that Chapter 11...'), not an assertion about the debt deadline. Note (not flagged as an error, since it's outside the specific claim the bot disclosed): Advanced Television also states the filing itself occurred 'on August 2nd' — a third date the article does not surface — but the article never asserts a specific filing date as fact, only quotes SpaceNews's own 'said Aug. 3' framing, so this omission does not constitute a false claim.

ERROR FOUND: The Analysis section states 'The company's total revenue and adjusted OIBDA improved company-wide.' SpaceNews (source-0) actually reports the opposite for total revenue: 'Total revenue declined nearly 4% to around $3.6 billion, while adjusted operating income before depreciation and amortization (OIBDA) jumped to $681.2 million from $279.6 million.' Only OIBDA improved; total revenue declined. The article's claim that both 'improved company-wide' misstates its own cited source. This is a subordinate analytical claim (not in the headline, summary, or lead) and is corrected in a filed corrections record.
